experiences.description: Part of the Mercury Rewrite team at American Airlines, migrating a legacy Java RMI, in-memory architecture to Java microservices backed by a Couchbase data layer. Joined the project in March 2026 after a 3-month Java and Angular training program.
highlights: Delivered a proof of concept that retrieves 250K fares from a 42-million-record Couchbase dataset and renders them in the UI, enabling sorting across all 40-50 fare columns, which database-side sorting could not support.
Built an agentic mesh proof of concept by extending an open-source repository with custom AI agents, now used by the team to accelerate development.
Owned end-to-end development of the Marketlist feature and led the design of its draft-table approach.
Created ops-core, a reusable framework born from the Marketlist design, now adopted by other modules of the project.
Received written recognition from the Project Manager for the quality of delivery as a fresher.

experiences.description: Built a quantum-resistant VPN as part of the internship.
highlights: Integrated Kyber (KEM) and Dilithium (signatures) into StrongSwan using liboqs.
Modified IKEv2 negotiation and the crypto backend for post-quantum key exchange and authentication; configured and tested tunnels with swanctl.
